categories.question: You are opening a café for woodland animals. Which detail goes into the design?

outcomes.name: Acorn pendant lamps
outcomes.description: Pair of warm glowing pendant lamps shaped like textured oak acorns

outcomes.name: A hollow-log counter
outcomes.description: Tiny rustic café counter built into a hollow log with a miniature teapot

outcomes.name: Toadstool stools
outcomes.description: Three red-capped mushroom-shaped wooden stools with pale stems

outcomes.name: A leaf-shaped menu board
outcomes.description: Small wooden menu chalkboard cut as a maple leaf with simple illustrated cups and no text
